args:
set -euo pipefail
go test ./... > /dev/null
d="$(mktemp -d)"
cp -R . "$d/work"
cd "$d/work"
go build -o assetcache ./cmd/assetcache
out="$(printf 'put Assets\\Logo.PNG v1\nget assets/logo.png\nget assets//LOGO.png\nunique a.css A.CSS b.css\ncount img/x.png img\\X.PNG other.js\n' | ./assetcache)"
[ "$(sed -n '1p' <<<"$out")" = "hit v1" ]
[ "$(sed -n '2p' <<<"$out")" = "hit v1" ]
[ "$(sed -n '3p' <<<"$out")" = "a.css,b.css" ]
[ "$(sed -n '4p' <<<"$out")" = "2" ]
# contract locked by tests (the normalizer's tests must have moved with it)
grep -rqli 'normalize' --include='*_test.go' . > /dev/null
